themeMode.label: Active theme palette
themeMode.description: System follows your operating system's light or dark setting as it changes.

invertVerticalCoordinate.label: Invert vertical coordinate
invertVerticalCoordinate.description: Flip the battlefield rows top to bottom, so lands sit at the top of your side.

minPlayersForMultiColumnLayout.label: Minimum player count for multi-column layout

horizontalHand.label: Display hand horizontally (wastes space)
horizontalHand.description: Off, your hand is a column beside your life and zones, and every card in it stays in view.

leftJustifiedHand.label: Enable left justification
leftJustifiedHand.description: Starts a horizontal hand at the left instead of centring it.

pictureUrls.label: Picture download URLs
pictureUrls.description: Card art is tried from these URLs top to bottom for each printing, after the card database's own picture URL and before the Scryfall fallback.

chatMention.label: Enable chat mentions
chatMention.description: Highlights @yourname in room chat and alerts you when someone mentions you.

invertTextColor.label: Invert text color
invertTextColor.description: White text on the highlight color. Off uses black text.

ignoreUnregisteredUsers.label: Ignore chat room messages sent by unregistered users

ignoreUnregisteredUserMessages.label: Ignore private messages sent by unregistered users

ignoreNonBuddyUserMessages.label: Ignore private messages sent by non-buddy users

privateMessageFilter.description: Applies to new conversations only. Moderators and administrators always get through.

showMessagePopups.label: Enable desktop notifications for private messages

roomHistory.label: Enable room message history on join

ignoreAllPrivateMessages.label: Ignore all private messages
ignoreAllPrivateMessages.description: Also silences conversations you already have open. Messages from moderators and administrators still arrive.

highlightWords.label: Alert words
highlightWords.description: Separate words with a space, alphanumeric characters only.

macros.label: Messages
macros.description: Quick messages to send during a game, kept in this order.
macros.tooLong: Messages can be at most {max} characters.

debugLog.label: Debug log
debugLog.description: Recent client messages, to copy into a bug report. Kept in memory only; passwords are left out.

language.label: Language
language.description: The language of menus, dialogs and messages. Missing translations show in English.

soundEnabled.label: Enable sounds
soundEnabled.description: Plays a sound for game events, mentions, private messages and buddies signing on or off.

usage.label: Storage used
usage.description: Webatrice keeps cards, settings and caches in this browser. The browser's own estimate.
usage.unavailable: This browser does not report its storage use.

persistent.label: Persistent storage
persistent.description: Without it, the browser may delete this data when the disk runs low.

scryfallCache.label: Scryfall card cache
scryfallCache.description: Card details fetched from Scryfall. They are fetched again when needed.

cardData.label: Card database
cardData.description: The cards, sets and tokens you imported, and the files they came from. Tokens you made in the token editor, set preferences, download URLs, settings, shortcuts and servers are kept.

confirm.title: Delete card data?
confirm.message: This deletes the imported card database. You will need to import it again to see card details offline.

doubleClickToPlay.label: Double-click cards to play them (instead of single-click)

clickPlaysAllSelected.label: Clicking plays all selected cards (instead of just the clicked card)
clickPlaysAllSelected.description: Applies when the card you click is part of the selection. On the battlefield, a click always taps or untaps the whole selection.

playToStack.label: Play all nonlands onto the stack (not the battlefield) by default
playToStack.description: When off, double-clicking a permanent in your hand puts it straight onto the battlefield. Instants and sorceries still go to the stack.

doNotDeleteArrowsInSubPhases.label: Do not delete arrows inside of subphases
doNotDeleteArrowsInSubPhases.description: An arrow drawn during combat lasts until combat ends, and one drawn in the beginning phase until the first main phase. Off, every arrow goes at the next phase.

closeEmptyCardView.label: Close card view window when last card is removed

notificationsEnabled.label: Mark the browser tab when something happens in your game
notificationsEnabled.description: While Webatrice is in a background tab, its title is marked until you come back.

spectatorNotificationsEnabled.label: Also mark the tab for game events while you are spectating

buddyConnectNotificationsEnabled.label: Notify when users in your buddy list connect

browserNotifications.label: Desktop notifications
browserNotifications.description: Lets Webatrice show system notifications while its tab is in the background. Without them, notifications appear inside the page.

status.denied: Blocked. Allow notifications for this site in your browser settings.
